body.purpose: Controls, forms, messages, and gameplay copy.

label.purpose: Tabs, fields, states, and compact controls.

motion.name: state-fast

components.name: Primary Action
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 3px solid var(--bright-border, #3d2b25); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--bright-pink, #ff9ebb); color: var(--bright-ink, #3d2b25); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--bright-border, #3d2b25); font: 900 14px/1.2 var(--font-ui-default, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: transform 160ms ease, filter 160ms ease, outline-color 160ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.04) saturate(1.04); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--bright-blue, #9ad3de); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--bright-border, #3d2b25); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Familiar secondary action with the same sticker silhouette.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 3px solid var(--bright-border, #3d2b25); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--bright-sheet-clean, #ffffff); color: var(--bright-ink, #3d2b25); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--bright-border, #3d2b25); font: 900 14px/1.2 var(--font-ui-default, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: transform 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--bright-pink-soft, #ffdfeb); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--bright-blue, #9ad3de); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Authentication Input
components.description: Readable account field with explicit focus and invalid states.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--bright-muted, #6a554d); font: 700 14px/1.35 var(--font-ui-default, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 2px solid var(--bright-border, #3d2b25); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bright-sheet-clean, #ffffff); color: var(--bright-ink, #3d2b25); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-ui-default, system-ui, sans-serif); outline: none; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #6b5d5a; opacity: .76; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #6a554d; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--bright-pink, #ff9ebb); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 158, 187, .28); }

components.name: Segmented Choice
components.description: Two-state account mode control with stable geometry.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 6px; padding: 5px; } .ds-segmented button { min-height: 44px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--bright-muted, #6a554d); font: 800 14px/1.2 var(--font-ui-default, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented button:hover { background: var(--bright-pink-soft, #ffdfeb); color: var(--bright-ink, #3d2b25); } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--bright-blue, #9ad3de); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-segmented .is-active { border-color: var(--bright-border, #3d2b25); background: var(--bright-pink, #ff9ebb); color: var(--bright-ink, #3d2b25); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--bright-border, #3d2b25); }

components.name: Bright School Panel
components.description: Notebook-paper surface for player-facing task regions.
components.html:
星炬学院围棋部

清晰、可靠、带有校园手账质感。
components.css: .ds-paper-panel { max-width: 420px; padding: 26px; border: 3px solid var(--bright-border, #3d2b25); border-radius: 16px; background-color: var(--bright-paper, #fffbf2); background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(154, 211, 222, .18) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(154, 211, 222, .18) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 20px 20px; color: var(--bright-ink, #3d2b25); box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 var(--bright-border, #3d2b25); font-family: var(--font-ui-default, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-paper-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 10px; font: 400 24px/1.2 var(--font-window-title, var(--font-ui-default, system-ui, sans-serif)); } .ds-paper-panel p { margin: 0; max-width: 38ch; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-paper-panel:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--bright-blue, #9ad3de); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: SigrikaGo presents a playful school-club world without weakening the precision required by a live strategy game. Paper surfaces, dark ink outlines, campus pink, notebook blue, and mint accents provide the anime-school energy; familiar controls, explicit states, and compact information hierarchy keep every action dependable.
keyCharacteristics: Warm notebook paper with visible but quiet grid structure.
Dark, high-contrast ink outlines and short hard shadows.
Pink for primary confirmation, blue and mint for supporting state roles.
Familiar form controls, explicit feedback, and legible game state before decoration.
Motion communicates state in roughly 160–250ms and disappears under reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Ink-First Rule
rules.body: A surface is not complete until its text, border, and active state remain readable without relying on color alone.

rules.name: The Familiar-Control Rule
rules.body: Buttons, labels, form values, and dense operational text always use the UI sans; display faces are reserved for identity and titles.

rules.name: The Short-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Bright School depth uses crisp paper offsets; broad blur is not the default visual language.

dos: Do make game state legible before making it decorative.
Do preserve the Bright School paper-and-campus identity while keeping standard controls familiar.
Do use explicit loading, error, unread, disabled, selected, and dangerous states.
donts: Don't let generic dark sci-fi HUD styling bleed into the Bright School theme.
Don't use marketing-page hero layouts inside app surfaces.
Don't add decorative motion that does not communicate state.
Don't build overbuilt card stacks or vague AI-tool aesthetics.
Don't use unreadable low-contrast paper tints.
Don't allow mobile overflow or treat mobile as a late shrink pass.
Don't replace context with modal flows when a separate detail window is expected.
